<function name="GetColor" parent="DLabelURL" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Gets the current text color of the <page>DLabelURL</page>. Returns either <page>DLabelURL:GetTextColor</page> or if that is unset -  <page>DLabelURL:GetTextStyleColor</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Color">The current text <page>Color</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
